added: packages/autonomy (@sos-2/autonomy): the frozen autonomy LEVEL ladder — SUPERVISED (rank 0: a currently-valid covering grant AND an explicit spine-referenced authority decision for the specific request; grants alone never permit), BOUNDED (rank 1: a currently-valid covering grant suffices — the W1/R15 model 'autonomy is bounded by explicit, evaluable grants'), AUTONOMOUS_LOW_RISK (rank 2: the same grant requirement PLUS the risk profile must stay in the autonomous-safe region — risk LOW and reversibility REVERSIBLE) — a small documented, totally-ranked ladder

packages/autonomy policy table: REQUIRED_LEVEL_TABLE — the default required level per (action kind x blast radius), total over the 5 frozen @sos-2/authority grant permissions (READ, REVISE, RETIRE, PROMOTE, DELEGATE — CONSUMED as the action-kind vocabulary, never redefined) x the 4 frozen blast radii (COMPONENT, SERVICE, SYSTEM, ORGANIZATION); the effective level is the default RAISED by applicable grant-backed raise artifacts (rank max — raises only ever increase autonomy)

packages/autonomy escalation matrix: the risk x irreversibility matrix — total over the 4x3 grid of @sos-2/authority's frozen ASK risk severities x the 3 frozen reversibility classes: SEVERE escalates at any reversibility; HIGH escalates unless fully REVERSIBLE; MODERATE escalates only when IRREVERSIBLE; LOW never escalates by the matrix; escalationOutcome is a pure function of (risk, reversibility) — NO confidence input exists anywhere in the API (the locked invariant 'confidence alone authorizing risky changes' is enforced structurally)

packages/autonomy enforcement: evaluateAuthorityCoverage (the authority dimension: grants, raises, level satisfaction) and evaluateAutonomy (coverage + the matrix) — grant evaluation CONSUMED VERBATIM from @sos-2/authority (assertValidGrant + evaluateGrant + scopeCovers + the frozen permission vocabulary); verdicts PERMITTED / DENIED (structured codes EXPIRED, REVOKED, NO_GRANT, PERMISSION_MISSING, SCOPE_MISMATCH, INDETERMINATE_EVALUATION) / ESCALATED (SUPERVISED_REQUIRES_EXPLICIT_DECISION, LOW_RISK_PROFILE_VIOLATION, RISK_IRREVERSIBILITY_ESCALATION); dead grants dominate alive-but-insufficient grants; indeterminate evaluation is never silently VALID (the W9 mapping); verdicts are presentation-order independent (authorizing grant = first qualifying by sorted id)

packages/autonomy raises: GOVERNED autonomy raises — AutonomyRaise artifacts (explicitly-registered spine extension kind via the sanctioned add-only registerArtifactKind API — the W3 ProvenanceRecord / W5 CorrelationRecord / W8 RecoveryDeclaration precedent); authorizeAutonomyRaise REQUIRES an explicit authority grant FOR THE RAISE ITSELF (VALID at the raise's evaluation point, scope covering the raise's scope, carrying the action kind's permission, raise expiry within the grant's expiry via authority's expiryIsWithin), a strictly-increasing to_level anchored to the table default, and a non-empty rationale — SILENT raises are impossible by construction (pinned by negative tests); at enforcement time a raise applies ONLY when its backing grant is presented, currently VALID, permissive and covering — an unprovable raise is ignored, which always falls back toward the MORE restrictive default (fail-closed)

packages/decision (@sos-2/decision): the decision ENGINE evaluate(request) -> DecisionRecord — deterministic and total; the outcome is EXACTLY one of the frozen six (ACT, EXPERIMENT, GATHER_EVIDENCE, ASK, REJECT, ROLLBACK — consumed from @sos-2/authority's DECISION_ACTIONS, never redefined); typed decision inputs (proposed action, evidence set, authority grants, uncertainty, impact, risk, reversibility, blast radius, rollback signals, evaluation instant, optional confidence mark); explicit deterministic rule order R0 SHAPE -> R1 AUTHORITY -> R2 SAFETY -> R3 EVIDENCE -> R4 UNCERTAINTY -> R5 ACT (documented tie priority: authority first, then safety, then evidence — pinned by rule-order tests)

packages/decision authority mapping: R1 consults the autonomy policy — a DEAD grant (EXPIRED/REVOKED) REJECTS (dead authority authorizes nothing, mirroring W9); insufficient authority (NO_GRANT, SCOPE_MISMATCH, PERMISSION_MISSING, INDETERMINATE_EVALUATION) yields ASK with escalation code AUTHORITY_INSUFFICIENT (the first-class ask-the-authority outcome, R16); SUPERVISED-without-explicit-decision and LOW_RISK_PROFILE_VIOLATION yield ASK; CONFIDENCE IS NEVER CONSULTED (the request's optional Confidence mark — @sos-2/evidence's contract, calibrated only with a calibration artifact ref — is digested, recorded and displayed, never read by any rule; pinned: 0.99- and 0.999999-calibrated requests in the high-risk/low-reversibility corner still escalate)

packages/decision safety mapping: R2 — non-empty wired rollback signals -> ROLLBACK; the risk x irreversibility matrix corner -> ASK regardless of confidence; R3 evidence (consumed from @sos-2/evidence): the simulation mark (@sos-2/experiments' isSimulatedRecord, checked FIRST — W9 discipline) -> REJECT; LLM-produced records never satisfy (§18); causal claims without real interventional evidence -> EXPERIMENT, existing-but-not-current -> GATHER_EVIDENCE; non-causal HIGH/CRITICAL impact without current SUCCESS evidence -> GATHER_EVIDENCE; subject binding follows the request target (ARTIFACT: exact artifact; KIND: parsed subject kind); R4 uncertainty (the frozen ASK contract classes): IRREDUCIBLE -> ASK, HIGH -> GATHER_EVIDENCE

packages/decision records: DecisionRecord — Decision-kind spine artifacts (deterministic content-addressed ids, the frozen core kind) carrying the action, the engine version, the EXACT INPUT DIGEST (canonical sha-256 over the request — the R30 reproducibility anchor), the ORDERED rule trace (contiguous 1..n entries with rule, outcome, code, reason — a decision without a rule trace is REJECTED by validation), the risk/impact request summary, the consulted-authority trace (required/effective levels, verdict code, grant refs, applied raises), the escalation block (REQUIRED iff action is ASK), the resolution block (REQUIRED iff the resolution path), the sorted evidence refs and the non-empty reasons; re-evaluation of the same input yields the BYTE-IDENTICAL record (pinned by unit + property tests); verifyDecision re-evaluates and rejects tampered/non-reproducible records

packages/decision resolution: mintResolutionDecision — an ASK resolved by a human/authority decision produces a DecisionRecord through the decision package's own record machinery with the provenance of who resolved it (resolved-by:<who> + ask:<id> appended to the record provenance; the id derives over the creation address including that provenance); the resolution binds to the ORIGIN decision's exact input digest, carries exactly one RESOLUTION rule-trace entry, and rejects foreign alternative ids, non-ASK origins and ASK-action alternatives (re-asking is a new AskRequest)

packages/ask (@sos-2/ask): the routing/presentation layer ON TOP of @sos-2/authority's frozen AskRequest contract (consumed through createAskRequest/validateAskContent/assertValidAskRequest — never redefined): composeAskContent derives the AskContent from an ASK decision record (the EXACT decision string, the documented default TYPED alternative sets per escalation code, derived qualitative evidence quality NONE/WEAK/MODERATE/STRONG, the uncertainty statement, deterministic trade-offs, the typed risk, and the authority-insufficiency reason from the escalation message); assembleEscalationContext joins the ask + the origin ASK record + the evidence records with CURRENT freshness (re-evaluated through @sos-2/evidence's evaluateFreshness at the presentation instant; missing records are reported truthfully as provided: false — never silently fresh or stale)

packages/ask queue: AskQueue — ordered (severity priority first: SEVERE > HIGH > MODERATE > LOW, then FIFO by enqueued_at, then ask id), deduplicated by the ORIGIN decision's exact input digest (idempotent enqueue: the same escalated input is queued exactly once, whether pending or already resolved — only a CHANGED input, i.e. a different digest, produces a new ask); resolve(entryId, resolution) mints the resolution DecisionRecord through @sos-2/decision (provenance of who resolved it, bound to the origin's digest) and marks the entry RESOLVED (terminal — an entry resolves at most once); ASK IS A SUCCESS STATE (R16): enqueueing a valid ask never throws (pinned by unit + property tests)
preserved_invariants: the Decision/ASK vocabulary is consumed from @sos-2/authority's frozen DECISION_ACTIONS — exactly the six outcomes; no new outcome is invented, no outcome is redefined (spec/architecture-lock.md 'Decision/ASK semantics'); ASK remains a SUCCESS state (a valid first-class outcome), never an error class — pinned by tests in all three packages

'confidence alone authorizing risky changes' remains forbidden (spec/architecture-lock.md): the risk x irreversibility matrix is a pure function of (risk, reversibility) with NO confidence input in the autonomy API; the decision engine's optional confidence mark is digested, recorded and displayed but never read by any rule — pinned by negative tests (0.99- and 0.999999-calibrated requests in the corner still escalate to ASK)

'unauthorized autonomy increases' remain forbidden (spec/architecture-lock.md / ARCHITECT_START_HERE.md): autonomy raises are minted ONLY through authorizeAutonomyRaise with an explicit, currently-valid, scope-covering, action-permissive authorizing grant, a strictly-increasing level anchored to the policy-table baseline, and an expiry within the grant's; silent raises throw loudly (pinned by negative tests); at enforcement, raises without proven backing are ignored, which falls back toward the MORE restrictive default (fail-closed, never fail-open)

expired and revoked grants NEVER authorize (the W1/W9 invariant): the autonomy enforcement consumes @sos-2/authority's evaluateGrant and maps dead grants to DENIED regardless of level; the decision engine maps them to REJECT (authority first — the documented tie priority)

indeterminacy is never silently VALID: a revision-bound grant evaluated at the decision instant is DENIED INDETERMINATE_EVALUATION by the autonomy enforcement and escalates to ASK in the decision engine (the W9 mapping); LLM output is never authoritative evidence or authorization (§18); simulated records are rejected loudly (the W9 layer-6 discipline — the mark is checked before shape)

intervention evidence outranks observational correlation for strong causal claims (§18): causal decision requests without current intervention-grade SUCCESS evidence land on EXPERIMENT/GATHER_EVIDENCE, never ACT (pinned by tests)

the Semantic Spine remains the ONLY identity/envelope/kind/serialization authority: decision records are Decision-kind spine envelopes with deterministic content-addressed ids (exactly like @sos-2/promotion's); AskRequests come from @sos-2/authority's contract; AutonomyRaise is an explicitly-registered add-only extension kind (no frozen core kind is touched, no second registry exists); risk severities, uncertainty classes, evidence-quality classes, grant permissions and the Decision actions are all consumed from their owning authorities — never redefined here

no frozen contract in spec/contracts/ was modified; spec/, docs/, root files and sibling-owned paths are untouched — all changes are additive under the three owned paths packages/autonomy, packages/decision and packages/ask (the W10 owned-path contract)
boundary_changes: three new workspace packages: @sos-2/autonomy (runtime deps @sos-2/authority, @sos-2/semantic-spine), @sos-2/decision (runtime deps @sos-2/authority, @sos-2/autonomy, @sos-2/evidence, @sos-2/experiments, @sos-2/semantic-spine) and @sos-2/ask (runtime deps @sos-2/authority, @sos-2/decision, @sos-2/evidence, @sos-2/semantic-spine) — one-directional, acyclic: ask -> decision -> autonomy -> authority -> spine

the autonomy policy consumes @sos-2/authority's frozen permission vocabulary AS the action-kind vocabulary (one action vocabulary, not two — no second authority); the decision engine consumes @sos-2/experiments' isSimulatedRecord for the simulation mark (no re-implementation); the impact ladder (LOW, MODERATE, HIGH, CRITICAL), blast radii (COMPONENT, SERVICE, SYSTEM, ORGANIZATION), reversibility classes (REVERSIBLE, PARTIALLY_REVERSIBLE, IRREVERSIBLE) and autonomy levels are NEW typed vocabularies owned by these packages — decision-input dimensions, not redefinitions of any frozen contract vocabulary
one explicitly-registered spine extension kind: AutonomyRaise (add-only registerArtifactKind — the established precedent); no new core kinds, no envelope field changes, no trace-link changes
